analysis.visual_description: On the tables. The tables opened on the board after dinner. The same four lines. A crumb is not on the leaf. The bundle is still apart.
On the tables. The stylus is in his hand and does not touch. Grease is on a finger and not on the leaf.
On the tables. He looks at the place where the rubbed word was. He does not write it back. The knot is unchanged.
